IsCoherentRing.toIsCoherent: The typeclass instance extracts coherence of the ring as a module over itself from the coherent-ring property.
IsCoherentRing.coherent: This class-field projection returns the stored coherence proof for the ring viewed as its own module.
IsCoherentRing.mk: The constructor packages coherence of the ring as a module over itself into the coherent-ring property. Its native source range is the class declaration.
Module.IsCoherent.toFinite: The typeclass instance extracts finite generation from a coherent module; no coherent-ring hypothesis is required.
Module.IsCoherent.finitePresentation_sub: This field of the coherence property supplies finite presentation of a submodule when a proof of finite generation of that submodule is given.
Module.IsCoherent.finite: This class-field projection extracts the finite-generation component of the coherence property.
Module.IsCoherent.mk: The constructor packages finite generation and finite presentation of every finitely generated submodule. Its native source range is the class declaration, not a separate source-level mk definition.
ModuleCat.isCoherentIsClosedUnderFiniteP: The coherent-module object property is closed under finite products, using the binary-product and zero-object instances. The base ring need not be coherent.
ModuleCat.isCoherentIsClosedUnderBinaryP: A binary product of coherent objects of ModuleCat is coherent. This closure is part of the inherited full-subcategory construction.
ModuleCat.isCoherentIsClosedUnderCokerne: Cokernels of morphisms between coherent ModuleCat objects remain coherent, by the quotient-by-range construction.
ModuleCat.isCoherentIsClosedUnderKernels: Kernels of morphisms between coherent ModuleCat objects remain coherent, using the underlying linear-map kernel and its categorical comparison.
ModuleCat.isCoherentContainsZero: The coherent-module object property contains a zero object, represented here by the subsingleton module PUnit.
ModuleCat.isCoherentIsClosedUnderIsomorp: An isomorphism in ModuleCat transports coherence through its underlying linear equivalence.
IsUniversallyCoherent.isCoherentRing: This field returns coherence of a finitely presented commutative algebra in the class's specified target universe. The target universe is independent of the base-ring universe.
IsUniversallyCoherent.mk: The constructor packages coherence of every finitely presented commutative algebra in the chosen target universe. Its native source range is the class declaration.
